senses.gloss: prefix (= b. h. מִמּ־) from, of. הֵימֶנִּי from me; הֵימֶךָּ from thee; הֵימֶנּוּ, הֵימֶנָּהּ from him, her (it).
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 9a">Ned. 9ᵃ</cite> he said <he>הריני עלי הימנו</he> ‘I will be’ (a Nazir), ‘upon me’ (shall the vow of an offering rest), and ‘from it’ (I will abstain).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:5:2">Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אין לוקחין הֵימֶינּוּ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 4:7">Bekh. IV, 7</cite>, sq. <he>ממנו</he>, Talm. 29ᵇ <he>ה׳</he> interch. with <he>ממנו</he>) you must not buy of him &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:5">Gen. R. s. 87</cite> <he>למעלה הימנה</he> on top of it (the bed).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:13">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>ויצילך הימנו</he> and save thee from it (the fire); a. fr.—<he>לא כל הימנו</he> not all depends on him, i.e. he has no right, it is not in his power.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לא כל הימנו לבור וכ׳</he> He had no right to choose for Himself the heavens &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:19">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>לא הימך לומר ליתן וכ׳</he> you had no right to order &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>וכל הימך וכ׳</he> have you a right to say &c.? v. <cite ref="K00668"><he>כֹּל</he></cite>.
